description: This file defines the class reqCommands, which encapsulates various operations related to requirements management in the TestLink project. It includes methods for creating, editing, deleting, copying, and reordering requirements, managing requirement versions, handling relations between requirements, and related GUI initialization logic.

classes.name: reqCommands
classes.description: This class provides comprehensive management functions for requirements in TestLink, including CRUD operations, version control, relation management, and GUI preparation.

methods.name: initGuiBean
methods.description: Initializes and returns a GUI data object with default values and properties for requirement-related interfaces.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new requirement based on provided arguments and request data.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares data for editing an existing requirement, optionally overwriting scope.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation process of a new requirement, including validation and logging.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Performs update operations on an existing requirement, handling change detection and revision prompts.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes a requirement or requirement version, with logging and GUI message preparation.

methods.name: doUnfreezeVersion
methods.description: Unfreezes (opens) a specific requirement version for editing.

methods.name: reorder
methods.description: Prepares data for reordering requirement children within a requirement specification.

methods.name: doReorder
methods.description: Executes the reordering of requirement nodes based on provided order.

methods.name: createTestCases
methods.description: Prepares GUI for creating test cases linked to requirements.

methods.name: doCreateTestCases
methods.description: Creates test cases from requirements in bulk.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Prepares GUI for duplicating a requirement.

methods.name: doCopy
methods.description: Copies a requirement to another location, with audit logging.

methods.name: doCreateVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of a requirement, optionally based on an existing version.

methods.name: doDeleteVersion
methods.description: Deletes a specific version of a requirement.

methods.name: doCreateRevision
methods.description: Creates a new revision of an existing requirement version.

methods.name: simpleCompare
methods.description: Compares two sets of requirement data to identify changes, prompts for revision if needed.

methods.name: doFreezeVersion
methods.description: Freezes (closes) a requirement version.

methods.name: addTestCase
methods.description: Associates an external test case with a requirement version.

methods.name: removeTestCase
methods.description: Removes association of a test case from a requirement version.

methods.name: fileUpload
methods.description: Handles uploading a file to attach to a requirement version.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes an attached file from a requirement version.

methods.name: initGuiObjForAttachmentOperations
methods.description: Initializes GUI object context for attachment upload/download operations.

methods.name: stopMonitoring
methods.description: Stops monitoring (tracking) a requirement.

methods.name: startMonitoring
methods.description: Starts monitoring (tracking) a requirement.

methods.name: doAddRelation
methods.description: Adds a relation from one requirement to another, with validation.

methods.name: doDeleteRelation
methods.description: Removes a relation between requirements.

methods.name: doCreateVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of an existing requirement.
